From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Quick: embeddings pricing (dims + discounts)

Hi Asha —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front, then I attached a one-page rate card PDF and a draft SOW for the pilot.

1) Pricing model: hosted embeddings are billed per-vector by default. We also offer a per-token option for some customer workflows (mostly when embedding is done as part of a generation pipeline). Per-vector is simpler for semantic search and predictable for storage cost modeling.

2) Dimensionality: price scales with vector size because larger dims cost more in compute and storage. Typical breakpoints: 1024d, 1536d, 2048d, 4096d. In the attached rate card we list baseline list prices (hosted API):
   - 1536d: $0.00045 per vector (list)
   - 2048d: $0.0007 per vector (list)
   - 4096d: $0.0018 per vector (list)

   Example math for one-time encode of 10,000,000 vectors (list price):
   - 1536d: 10M * $0.00045 = $4,500
   - 4096d: 10M * $0.0018 = $18,000

   These numbers reflect hosted encoding + tokenization/compute; they do not include long-term vector storage (we can provide storage estimates separately or you can bring your own vector DB and only use Redwood for encoding).

3) Supported models: we support Redwood-verified embedding models (redwood-embed-1-small 1024d, redwood-embed-2 1536d, redwood-embed-2-large 4096d) plus several community/open checkpoints (listed in the PDF). Redwood models have continuous quality monitoring and we surface regression alerts if a model's similarity scores drift on your eval set (we can include your eval set in monitoring as part of a pilot).

4) Volume discounts: standard tiers in the sheet are:
   - 0–1M vectors: list price
   - 1M–10M: 10% off list
   - 10M–50M: 20% off list
   - 50M+: custom pricing (we commonly offer 25–40% depending on commitment length)

   For 10M vectors that would typically put you at the top of the 1M–10M band (10% off) or at 20% off if you commit to a 12-month prepay. With a straightforward 12-month committed spend we can push to 20%–25%.

Pilot / credits: we offer a 30–60 day pilot with credits (usually $2k–$10k depending on scope). For a 50k-document eval set we can give a $1,000–$2,000 credit and instrument monitoring so you see quality and cost by prefix.

I asked Ben (cc'd) to share a sample SOW template and to help size a storage estimate if you want Redwood to host vectors. If you'd like a dedicated pricing proposal, let us know target ARR or committed vector volumes and term (monthly vs 12mo prepay).

Attaching: redwood-embeddings-ratecard-2026-05.pdf, draft SOW.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call tomorrow to walk through scenarios.

—Karthik

Hi Asha / Sarah —

Answers inline and next steps: 

- Encode-only monthly estimate (1M vectors/mo at 1536d):
   List: 1,000,000 * $0.00045 = $450 per month (encoding only). At 10%/mo re-embed cadence for 10M corpus that equates to ~ $450/mo at list, or $360/mo at 20% committed discount.

- Discount applicability: the 12-month prepay / 20% figure is available for hosted API customers (no need to buy Dedicated). Dedicated is priced differently and usually requires a minimum committed GPU capacity—we can outline both if you'd like.

- Pilot comparison (1536d vs 4096d):
   - Cost: pilot cost grows roughly linearly with vector dim. 50k docs encode at 1536d ≈ 50k * $0.00045 = $22.50 (list); at 4096d ≈ 50k * $0.0018 = $90 (list). We will cover pilot credits per our pilot offer (I suggested $1–2k earlier).
   - Latency: 4096d models have ~1.5–2x higher encode latency per request on the same hardware. For batched encoding this often maps to a modest wall-time delta but higher GPU usage. We will instrument latency buckets in the pilot results.

Next steps I propose:
- I will open a HubSpot quote with two options: (A) Hosted API, 12-month prepaid volume for 10M vectors with 20% discount; (B) Hosted API, commit to 1M vectors/mo (month-to-month) with a 10% tiered discount.
- We'll run the 50k eval pilot (we provide $2k credit) comparing redwood-embed-2 (1536d) and redwood-embed-2-large (4096d) and send a short report with similarity/recall metrics + latency/cost.

Ben / Grace: can you review and approve a 20% hosted prepay discount for DL-2026-0523-007 if SearchLytics signs a 12-month commitment for 10M vectors (or equivalent spend)? If approved I'll prepare a formal quote and attach the SOW for signature.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call to align procurement.

—Karthik
